variants.briefing:
Hi,

If we want regular people to move to this system, we need to show them that basic services are reliable. Making things like delivery runs dependable so people don’t think twice about them is exactly what the Citizens for Prosperity are here to do. Care to help us with this? 

There’s a few boxes waiting at [Location] that need to get to [Destination]. Can you get those supplies to the outpost for us? This might be a simple supply run, but doing these consistently only strengthens our position in the system. 

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
